northStar: The security-printed travel document: every credit stamped before its window closes.

shadows.document-frame: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--card), inset 0 0 0 5px var(--hairline), 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.04 262 / 6%), 0 12px 32px -18px oklch(0.2 0.04 262 / 28%)

textures.security-paper: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, var(--microline) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px), repeating-linear-gradient(65deg, var(--microline) 0 1px, transparent 1px 11px)

motion.default: transition-colors 150ms ease-out; content visible by default; prefers-reduced-motion collapses all durations

rules: Stamp law: vermilion only for a window that is closing or a charge-by date.
One document-frame object and one guilloche rosette per first viewport.
Field labels name document facts; never a kicker above a heading.
No issuer or network marks; card art is studio-generated.
